benchmark_name: Preselected Conjugation-2A 2sg past attestation challenge v15

measured_result.unknown_safety: 8/8 for combined runtime and master exact
measured_result.historical_interpretation: The untouched runtime did not recognize the independently attested buuxisay row because generic C2A past authorized only 2pl and 3pl. This establishes a clean 2sg-past baseline before any post-freeze 2sg activation. caajisi remains unresolved and is excluded from scoring.

answer_sources.source_family: City of Minneapolis School Based Clinics Somali minor consent form
answer_sources.attested_context: Fadlan u soo gudbi foomka oo aad buuxisay Xarunta Caafimaadka ee Dugsiga.
answer_sources.feature_resolution: The document addresses the reader directly. In the relative clause foomka oo aad buuxisay, aad marks a second-person subject and the already-completed form is the object, supporting a 2sg past/completed-event reading. The lexical use is directly compatible with the reviewed buuxi sense 'fill up or out'. Mood is outside the scored scope.

verification.screenshot_failure: web screenshot endpoint returned a cache miss

independent_corroboration.attested_context: Foomka aad buuxisay waxaad u dhiibeysaa hogaamiyaha xilli firaaqada...

unresolved_targets.reason: Searches found many caajisay tokens meaning 'became/got bored', but the reviewed target caajisi is a distinct transitive C2A lemma meaning 'debilitate; weaken; tire someone out'. No trustworthy context was found that both resolves a 2sg subject and disambiguates the token to transitive caajisi. No surface is inferred from the class pattern.

experimental_design.purpose: Test an unsupported C2A 2sg past cell on preselected, long-authorized class lemmas. Score only independently attested and lemma-disambiguated surfaces, leaving ambiguous or unresolved targets unjudged rather than inferred.

independence_limits.reason: v15 is deliberately narrow. It scores one semantically and syntactically resolved preselected 2sg-past surface and preserves caajisi as unresolved because common homographic-looking tokens could not be safely assigned to the transitive target lemma.

notes: PR #42 merged the answer-free target registry before any external lookup. PR #43 froze the one attested buuxisay row with caajisi unresolved and no runtime changes. PR #44 then measured the untouched runtime at 0/1 recognition and 0/1 deep features with 8/8 unknown safety on a 1147/1147 green suite. The historical baseline is locked before any 2sg runtime expansion.
